title: Blue Composition
provenance: Acquired by the estate of Mrs. Lim Ah Lian in 1975, sold to Haji Ibrahim bin Abdullah's private collection by 1982 and later passed through Soo Onn & Sons Art Gallery before being consigned to Meridian Fine Arts Auctioneers in 2023.
previous_owner: Collection of the late Dato' R. Sivanathan
